question: A, B, C, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre(but not necessarily in the same order). X sits to the immediate left of A. Only one person sits between X and Z. C sits second to the right of B. Y is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Z?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) X sits to the immediate left of A.
